messages:
rachel: Posting follow-ups from today's all-hands re: reviews/promos/comp. I'll compile answers here.
maria: Thanks @rachel. I'll put short answers then expand if needed.
nate: Quick Q: if someone goes on protected leave during calibration window, do we pause their review? what's recommended?
maria: We usually pause for protected leaves >2 weeks during calibration. Manager files "Pause Review" form and we reschedule. We annotate calibration notes to prevent bias.
olivia: If paused, does effective date shift for promotion/comp? any retro pay?
maria: Effective date shifts to the new agreed date. Retro pay only in exceptional cases, handled case-by-case.
hr-bot: Links: <https://company-notion/people-ops/leave-review-guidelines|Leave & review guidelines> · <https://company-notion/people-ops/pause-form|Pause review form>
rachel: Managers also asked: what's the fastest path for a mission-critical out-of-cycle promo?
maria: Submit Expedited Promo intake flagged "business-critical" with customer/impact evidence. Target turnaround 10 business days; may need Product/Comp signoffs depending on size.
nate: Appeals: if an IC thinks they were under-leveled, timeline and steps please.
maria: Appeal steps: 1) team talk -> 2) file appeal within 30 days -> 3) People Ops expedited review target 30 days. For bias concerns we can route to independent committee. We'll share anonymized rationale with the employee.
olivia: Can managers get canned language for denial conversations?
maria: Yes — adding "Denial + development plan" script to manager toolkit by Friday. Short sample: "Thanks for the work. After calibration we couldn't approve this cycle because X. Here's a 90-day plan..."
rachel: Any updates to band ranges or location differentials this quarter?
maria: Minor band re-anchors for high-growth markets; location differential table updated in comp doc. We'll highlight diffs in Notion on Monday.
hr-bot: Action created: weekly-promo-digest subscription started for managers and people-ops.
rachel: I'll add these notes to the all-hands follow-up doc and share links. Thanks everyone. :white_check_mark:
